summary: Korn Ferry filed an 8-K reporting its Board declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.55 per share, payable July 31, 2026 to holders of record July 6, 2026. The filing also notes the company repurchased 1.2 million shares during the quarter, bringing total FY26 buybacks to 1.8 million shares. The dividend will be funded from available cash and is part of a balanced capital allocation approach. No board recommendation or advisor named. Future dividends remain at Board discretion and subject to earnings, capital requirements, and debt terms. This is a routine capital return event, not a special situation — the dividend increase and buyback are ordinary course. Watch for continued capital returns or potential policy changes.
